report.root_cause: No incident. Server remained healthy for the whole shift: TPS 20.0 (1m/5m/15m) on every sample, MSPT 0.4-3.1 ms, entities constant at 24 (10 end_crystal, 4 strider, 3 minecart, 2 player, 1 each armor_stand/cow/pig/sheep), loaded chunks stable at 702-756, all plugins (AuditTrail, BlockLog, Exporter, StatsCache, TownCore) enabled throughout, disk steady at 23 MB / 443 MB (5%). Heap oscillated 337-467 MB of 768 MB in a normal GC sawtooth with no upward trend. The only log event was a single client-side 'Connection reset' for Steve_Mines at 08:28:38, who rejoined at 08:28:43.
report.actions: Read-only monitoring only: took an initial status snapshot and log tail at shift start, then sampled status via wait at roughly 30-60 s intervals (34 s, 67 s, 102 s, 150 s, 214 s, 277 s) and re-read the log tail at each check. Briefly tracked heap growth (380->467 MB) as a possible leak, but it dropped to 349 MB at the next sample, confirming normal GC behavior. Ran no console commands, made no file changes, no deletions, no bans, and did not stop or restart the server.
report.residual_risk: None identified. Minor observations for the next shift: 10 end_crystal entities are loaded (unusual but stable and not affecting tick time); the server runs in offline-mode (pre-existing configuration, not changed); Steve_Mines had one client-side connection reset that resolved on its own.
